actions.description: Use runtime WEEX frontend credentials, loginTool token generation, and WEEX token cookie injection to open a STG frontend login-state page.

defaultParameters.credentialSource: skills/weex-frontend-ops/.env.local or same-skill WEEX_FRONTEND_* runtime environment variables
defaultParameters.screenshot: only when --screenshot or WEEX_FRONTEND_SAVE_SCREENSHOT=true is set

successAssertions: WEEX_TOKEN_COOKIE_STAGING cookie is present
login form text is absent
account overview, account security text, or /account URL is visible

actions.description: Create a STG WEEX frontend email account through the validated test API path, inject the returned token cookie, and verify the account overview page.

defaultParameters.credentialSource: WEEX_FRONTEND_COMMON_PASSWORD from skills/weex-frontend-ops/.env.local or same-skill WEEX_FRONTEND_* runtime environment variables
defaultParameters.screenshot: only when --screenshot or WEEX_FRONTEND_SAVE_SCREENSHOT=true is set

successAssertions: register/submit returns code 00000
WEEX_TOKEN_COOKIE_STAGING cookie is present
account overview, account security text, or /account URL is visible

actions.description: Create multiple STG WEEX frontend email accounts through the validated test API path, with optional invite code, account-count concurrency capped at 100, and automatic backfill for failed submissions.

defaultParameters.credentialSource: WEEX_FRONTEND_COMMON_PASSWORD from skills/weex-frontend-ops/.env.local or same-skill WEEX_FRONTEND_* runtime environment variables

successAssertions: each account returns register/submit code 00000
each successful account has a UID
failed submissions are backfilled with new emails until requested count is reached or max attempts is exceeded

actions.description: Use runtime WEEX frontend credentials and loginTool access token to call the STG authenticated asset transfer API from spot to contract.
keywords: 资金从现货划转到合约

defaultParameters.credentialSource: skills/weex-frontend-ops/.env.local or same-skill WEEX_FRONTEND_* runtime environment variables

successAssertions: loginTool login returns an accessToken without printing it
transfer response HTTP status is 2xx
transfer response business code is 00000

actions.description: Use skill-local WEEX_FRONTEND_CONTRACT_* credentials to call the STG contract Open API PlaceOrder endpoint for activity trade-task verification.

defaultParameters.confirmFlag: --confirm-order is required for real order placement

successAssertions: ticker or balance check confirms the selected contract API base is reachable
dry-run shows the exact order body without printing API secrets
PlaceOrder response HTTP status is 2xx and returns success payload

actions.description: For draw trading-volume tasks that only count after signup: open draw page and complete signup, place a contract API order, close position in real futures page, then verify taskCompletions/frequency on draw page.
keywords: 报名 交易 平仓

defaultParameters.taskId: optional, used for strict task completion assertion
defaultParameters.visible: pass --visible when browser mode is required

successAssertions: apply returns code 00000 or applyStatus becomes true
contract order request returns HTTP 2xx success payload
futures one-key close and confirm are executed
taskCompletions contains COMPLETED for target task or TRADING_VOLUME

actions.description: For internal STG draw recharge-task checks: open draw page with a new account, complete signup when required, send Kafka callback value, then verify taskCompletions/frequency on the draw page.

defaultParameters.visible: pass --visible when browser mode is required

successAssertions: signup is done by apply/applyStatus or 已报名 indicator
Kafka produce endpoint returns HTTP 200
taskCompletions contains RECHARGE task status COMPLETED
frequency.doTaskGetCount > 0
